story.title: A Wonderful Family Reunion
story.blurb: Four years after running away, Zach is returned to his father John's mansion on Earth, and must find a way off the planet before he is shut away for good.

lines.text: It was pure silence, Zach and John glaring at each other from opposite seats on the ship. So many things they wanted to say to each other, but didn't know where to start. To be honest, Zach would love nothing more than to just kill this man in front of him right now, but he knows he can’t harm a white hair on his head. He has more problems than the GU can throw at him, so he’ll just sulk at his own expense. He wonders if John wants to kill him… it has been 4 years….

lines.text: Zach wakes up with a start just as the door to the room opens, three men in suits walk in, with John following behind them, the suits grab Zach, but Zach isn’t having it.

Zach shoves them off and punches one in the face and kicks another in the stomach. They both crumple to the ground. The third pulls his gun but Zach grabs it out of his hand and aims at him. He puts his hand up in surrender. Zach gestures to the man to stand next to John, who hasn’t flinched once during the entire scuffle, with the gun. He does so and Zach takes a deep breath.

“Now then, here’s what I’m going to do and you are not going to interfere. I’m going to get off this God-forsaken planet and never return again. Because quite frankly, there’s no reason to stay here.” John is about to interrupt but Zach just tightens his grip on the gun. “Let me lay down the facts. I’ve been gone for four years. And in those four years you have gotten onto the GU Council, giving you more influential power and a fanbase who adore you. I have found a group that is more of a family than you ever could be. They let me be myself and if you haven’t noticed, my eyes and my voice are no longer hidden. And I love it that way. Hell, I found myself the greatest man out there and he doesn’t care why I hide my eyes or not talk. But now he thinks I’m dead because I got stuck with you. And in all that time, no one has questioned my family history and even if they did, no one would believe me. Now then, you are going to let me ‘waltz out of here’ and trust me, you won’t ever hear from me ever again.” His voice is hoarse from not using it for a while. John just looks at Zach with no emotion. After several minutes John finally spoke.
